## Description

Provide a summary of the change, why it was made, and link relevant issues.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test suite enhancement

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
- [ ] My code follows the repository's code style and conventions.
- [ ] All functions and classes are fully typed and pass `uv run mypy src/`.
- [ ] Code formatting and linting pass: `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .`.
- [ ] I have added unit tests covering my changes.
- [ ] All tests pass locally with `uv run pytest`.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / docstrings accordingly.
